proposal.summary: IBM TXSeries and CICS TX variants could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man-in-the-middle techniques.
proposal.affected_product: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1; CICS TX Standard 11.1; CICS TX Advanced 10.1 and 11.1
proposal.cwe_quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.

AV.quote: could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.

C.quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate endpoints that place sensitive data in URL query parameters, update applications to avoid placing secrets in URLs, and ensure all affected endpoints require and enforce TLS (HTTPS).

evidence_quotes.quote: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1, CICS TX Standard, 11.1, CICS TX Advanced 10.1, and 11.1
